commands.summary: Full Windows test discovery passed after correction.
Focused WI050 regressions and Windows bypass coverage passed.
No frozen-surface changes in the correction pass.
Wheel built successfully after editable installation of declared dev dependencies.
WSL is not installed and Docker is unavailable on this Windows host; no Linux/macOS closeout was attempted.

negative_regressions: No-lease mutation, repair, process, and frozen actions deny before callback or child creation.
Lease repository/WI/principal/session/profile/mode/scope/path/capability/lineage/base/expiry/revocation checks deny tampering and widening.
Repair requires a signed repair receipt, repair mode, and diagnosed paths; frozen requires signed frozen proof and current frozen digest.
Canonical approval writes reject arbitrary paths, symlinks, and overwrite attempts; noninteractive revoke leaves epoch unchanged.
Linked worktrees resolve only through the authenticated Git common directory; independent repositories remain unregistered.
Launcher denial is observed before subprocess creation; self-activation and --ack do not create authority.
final_security_claim: Within the Windows reference policy/guard and adapter boundaries, ordinary mutation authority is fail-closed on an operator-derived lease and cannot be widened by caller assertions, stale receipts, bootstrap paths, revocation calls, or linked-worktree path spelling. The reference filesystem backend does not claim protection from a same-principal attacker without a host-managed process/path boundary.

adapter_enforcement_classes.pre_action_reference: pre-action interception; callback is not invoked on denial
adapter_enforcement_classes.launcher_reference: session-start gate before subprocess creation; no arbitrary child path/process confinement claimed
adapter_enforcement_classes.platform_backends: not-covered unless host reports a real process and path boundary; integrity_checked is reported separately

remediations: mutation, process, repair, and frozen actions require an operator-derived lease
lease repository, work item, principal, session, profile, mode, scopes, paths, capabilities, lineage, base, expiry, and revocation are checked at action time
repair requires a direct repair approval, repair mode, and explicit diagnosed paths
frozen approval binds the declared frozen-surface digest and ignores caller receipt_verified flags
receipt class, expiry, epoch, algorithm, and authority version are bound and verified
bootstrap requests and receipts use canonical evidence paths with symlink and overwrite protection
revocation requires an operator-signed revoke receipt
linked worktrees resolve the authenticated registration through git-common-dir
reference filesystem health reports integrity separately from protection against the same principal
